title: Weapons and Tactics Instructor Aviation Command & Control (AC2) Maintenance Officer (II/III) (LtCol to Capt) and (CWO5 to CWO2) NMOS (5902, 5910, 5950, 5970), DC AVN
raw_text:
5. MOS 5977, Weapons and Tactics Instructor Aviation Command & Control (AC2)
Maintenance Officer (II/III) (LtCol to Capt) and (CWO5 to CWO2) NMOS (5902,
5910, 5950, 5970), DC AVN

    a. Summary. Weapons and Tactics Instructor AC2 Maintenance Officers
train and evaluate Marine air command and control personnel on aviation
sensors and weapons systems in the employment of the Marine Air Command and
Control System (MACCS) to support the Marine Air Ground Task Force.

       b.   Prerequisites.   Must hold MOS 5902, 5910, 5950, or 5970.

    c. Requirements. Must successfully complete the MAWTS-1 Weapons and
Tactics Instructor Course (M149731).

       d.   Duties

            (1) Manage a unit's Weapons and Tactics Training Program.

        (2) Perform classroom and operational instruction on various facets
of MACCS equipment/weapons systems including integration, employment
capabilities and limitations in support of the MAGTF and joint tasking.

            (3) Analyze performance and provide corrective guidance.

        (4) Instructs on current enemy capabilities and tactics to counter
their threat.

        (5) Recommend the most qualified personnel for nomination to the
Weapons and Tactics Instructor Course and unit instructor qualifications.




                                         1-237                          Enclosure (1)
 1134                                                           NAVMC 1200.1L



        (6) Ensures all training adheres to established training standards,
safety, and ORM procedures.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Teachers and Instructors, All Other 25-3099.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.




                                         1-238                   Enclosure (1)
 1135                                                                NAVMC 1200.1L

MAINTENANCE

5. MOS 5977, Weapons and Tactics Instructor Aviation Command & Control (AC2) Maintenance Officer (II/III) (LtCol to Capt) and (CWO5 to CWO2) NMOS (5902, 5910, 5950, 5970), DC AVN a. Summary. Weapons and Tactics Instructor AC2 Maintenance Officers train and evaluate Marine air command and control personnel on aviation sensors and weapons systems in the employment of the Marine Air Command and Control System (MACCS) to support the Marine Air Ground Task Force. b. Prerequisites. Must hold MOS 5902, 5910, 5950, or 5970. c. Requirements. Must successfully complete the MAWTS-1 Weapons and Tactics Instructor Course (M149731). d. Duties (1) Manage a unit's Weapons and Tactics Training Program. (2) Perform classroom and operational instruction on various facets of MACCS equipment/weapons systems including integration, employment capabilities and limitations in support of the MAGTF and joint tasking. (3) Analyze performance and provide corrective guidance. (4) Instructs on current enemy capabilities and tactics to counter their threat. (5) Recommend the most qualified personnel for nomination to the Weapons and Tactics Instructor Course and unit instructor qualifications. (6) Ensures all training adheres to established training standards, safety, and ORM procedures.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
